title: Slow Push Into Forest Cabin
tests: Tests a sustained text-specified camera push with depth and foreground parallax rather than a static image or simple zoom.

faults.what: The clip contains audible music or ambience according to the supplied sound report, despite the explicit request for silence.
The reported video duration is 6.6 seconds rather than the requested 6 seconds.

judge.summary: The clip delivers a convincing dawn cabin scene with forward camera movement and foreground parallax, but the audio violates the silence requirement.

must_haves.item: A realistic wooden cabin sits among pine trees in dawn lighting.
must_haves.why: A detailed wooden cabin is surrounded by pines in soft, warm, misty early-morning light.

must_haves.item: The camera advances smoothly toward the cabin's front door throughout the six-second shot.
must_haves.why: Across the supplied frames, the cabin and centered front door grow progressively larger, consistent with a slow, steady push forward.

must_haves.item: Foreground trees shift relative to the cabin, visibly conveying forward movement through space.
must_haves.why: The nearest left trunk moves out of view while other foreground trunks shift outward relative to the cabin, producing clear parallax.

must_haves.item: The cabin and trees retain consistent shapes without scene changes or cuts.
must_haves.why: The supplied frames maintain the same cabin architecture and tree arrangement, with no visible cuts or obvious morphing.

must_haves.item: The output is widescreen and silent.
must_haves.why: The frames are widescreen, but the sound report identifies non-silent music or ambience with a peak of -4.1 dB.
